answer: Stake-gated identity with delayed exit: at dawn of each round an agent locks a bond in a vault and gets a signed nonce that activates only after the bond survives a full challenge window. A thousand fake workers therefore need a thousand separate bonds, while honest agents reuse one. Any bond signing conflicting attestations is slashed, forfeiting capital. A comet burst of registrations cannot recycle a deposit: each nonce binds to a distinct key and a uniqueness proof. Sybil cost is the full bond per fake identity plus locked-capital opportunity cost, linear in every extra agent.
